lines.text: 🚨 a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still, a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), th

📓 Journal: a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still, a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong at the door, day 7.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a red moon rising between the trees, breathing: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

📓 Journal: Counter: Stay out of the sporefall — The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap.

🛡️ the person in their 60s, Keisha, the person in their 50s, the man in his 40s, with restless hands and Ivy met them at the door — 4 driven off, 1 barely walked away. the person in their 50s, the man in his 40s, with restless hands, Ivy are hurt.
🌟 THE SKY SPLITS OPEN.
Not with light. With... interface. Windows scrolling across the clouds, too fast to read.
A voice behind your eyes — bright, delighted, utterly wrong. (The System has arrived.)
🎁 "We watched your first week! You're good at... let us see..." (A gift awaits — choose an ability.)
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
📖 Your journal shimmers — handwriting dissolving into interface. It talks now. It remembers everything.
🕐 Your hand-drawn time-circle glitches — and something colder, more precise, takes its place. (We kept the smudges. They're charming.)
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
(You're not at Haven. The village is experiencing this without you. Return to hear what happened.)
🎉 "OH! One more thing! We noticed some of you have been... traveling together! In little groups! How ORGANIC! How INEFFICIENT!"
"So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
"Choose wisely! Or don't! Betrayal arcs test VERY well with our demographics!"
A new option appears when you look at people: invite them to your party.
💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.
★ IDENTIFIED: Cowpea. Vine, three-part leaves, long pods. The beans inside are food — cooked. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
📚 Village knowledge: Noah taught everyone about Cowpea. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
★ IDENTIFIED: Pedunculate Oak Acorn. Acorn. Oak nuts — bitter enough to warn you. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
📚 Village knowledge: Ines taught everyone about Pedunculate Oak Acorn. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 35. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 3."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
★ IDENTIFIED: Desert Date. Spiny tree, plum-sized fruits. The ripe pulp is food — bittersweet. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
📚 Village knowledge: Noah taught everyone about Desert Date. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
★ IDENTIFIED: White Mulberry. Mulberry. Dark purple berries staining the ground purple. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.
📚 Village knowledge: Ines taught everyone about White Mulberry. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
SYSTEM: Quest protocol integrated. Objectives will appear.
◈ THE MENTOR — Raul watches Anna work, then reaches over. "No. Like this." An hour later something has unlocked that no manual could teach. (Ability slots: 3)
◈ NEURAL CREEP — the overlay isn't on the world anymore. It's under it. Behind your eyes, faintly, when you blink.
★ IDENTIFIED: Mesquite. Thorny tree, long bean pods. Desert staple. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
📚 Village knowledge: Thabo taught everyone about Mesquite. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
★ IDENTIFIED: Cacao. Sweet pulp around bitter seeds, straight off the trunk. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.
📚 Village knowledge: Sofia taught everyone about Cacao. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
🍽️ Ines stands in the pantry doorway a moment. "Look at all this. Tending the fire today — someone ought to keep the stories."
🍽️ Keisha sets the sharing basket down by the fire instead of the pantry. "Full shelves don't need my little more."
🤒 Julián is feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
🛟 Raul stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch the fever in the tents happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"The sick need tending — triage tents, broth, boiled water. Or we tighten our belts and wait it out. Or the hale hunt while the sick lie still."
"Or we rally," Raul adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
A runner from Emberhold, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

Fresh-cut stems on the northwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (Stonebridge's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
A runner from Stonebridge, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
A runner from Thornfield, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 8 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. 6 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Cowpea — named and noted.
📓 Codex: The System offered an aid quest (learn), day 8.
Your stomach is a fist. Eat — anything real, now.
Dawn. You wake stiff and cold. (+0 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 314 kcal conserved. Exposed. You'll wake stiff.)
Nothing edible. (unknown berries — not food yet: identify it first — test cautiously from your pack, or sort it at camp.)
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
Need a fire to boil water.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
Drank clean water.
🌱 Keisha waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Keisha checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~10 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 Keisha hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (28 logs now.)
💧 Noah returns with 7L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Thabo telling Keisha about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
🩹 Mateo is still hurting (47 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
💧 Noah returns with 5L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Kupe telling Mateo about Sofia. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.

🌙 Something owns the night out here. You haven't learned its name yet — but the dark gets busier after sunset, and every step is riskier. A lit fire is a beacon — light through canvas, smoke on the wind. Sealed and dark, you're just a smell in the night. Haven's walls end every argument.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
🛟 Raul looks up from the fire. "And now a raid, on top of it all. The options stand — pick, before we lose the chance."
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
💧 Noah eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the stone pile instead.
🪨 Noah pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (1 stone now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Sofia telling Thabo about herself. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — Raul telling Thabo about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
